name: Hara'ni
title: The First Architecture
lingerie_note: CANONICAL: no lingerie layer for Hara'ni. Architecture is self-supporting via evolved fascia-cartilage lattice. Absence is correct canon state. See SSOT §10.3.21 lingerie protocol note.

species_measurements.bust_note: O-cup species baseline (population average across all adult females — minimum, not ceiling); tissue density 1.08 kg/L; evolved fascia-cartilage lattice
species_measurements.waist_note: Compressed lateral GI loop configuration permits narrow waist; 40cm is relaxed resting state
species_measurements.hips_note: Modified iliac geometry; cortical bone density 1.4× human average at iliac crest

adaptation_layers: mammary — volumetric amplification with integrated fascia-cartilage support lattice
skeletal — modified iliac geometry and 1.4× cortical density at load-bearing surfaces
digestive — compressed lateral GI loop configuration reducing mid-torso diameter
connective — inter-fascial tension network; structural geometry maintained across full 200-350yr lifespan
biology.ancestor_territory: Hara-Solanum (southeastern continental interior; elevated plateau; post-anomaly geological stability)

cultural_structure: Matriarchal theocracy — female architecture is the sacred form; governance and territorial decisions route through elder female councils
population: several thousands; concentrated in Hara-Solanum; smaller enclaves in major cities
systemic_role: First Civilization (pre-Triumvirate); Assessment Species — every Hara'ni encounter is, on their side, an evaluation
encounter_note: Hara'ni do not engage casually. Disinterest from a Hara'ni is not safe to mistake for approval. Any NPC Hara'ni in an urban setting operates under elder-council mandate.

lore.archetype: First Architecture — Vector 7 Species, Ancestral Matriarchal Civilization
lore.history: Pre-civilizational matriarchal species. 40,000 years biological divergence. No external taxonomic label accepted. Self-designated by primacy-of-form (hara = first/original) and structural identity (ni = a people defined by their architecture).

relationships.vlncnst: Vector 7 sister-axis: designed vs evolved. Two proofs of the same architectural theorem from non-equivalent derivation paths.
relationships.carmin: Human ceiling vs evolved non-human floor. Architectural axis requires both entries to be complete.
relationships.claudine: Recognition-based. Lateral recognition of structural equivalence across non-equivalent origins. No hierarchy applies.
